## About Us
Source: https://www.purephotoni.com/about-us

Tommy + Laurene

Hi, we're Tommy and Laurene, a husband and wife team based in Lisburn who genuinely love what we do. We've spent years photographing weddings all across Northern Ireland, from the North Coast to working as wedding photographers in Belfast, always in a way that feels relaxed and true to each couple.

Photography has been part of both our lives since we were kids, and that love of photography hasn't faded one bit since turning it into a full time career. If anything, it's grown. We put everything into every wedding we shoot, and we like to think that shows in the images we bring home.

We built our wee photography business on one simple idea, that your wedding photos should feel like you. Not stiff or posed, just real, emotional, and full of the moments you'll actually want to remember.

Who We Are

Outside of work, you'll usually find us on some kind of family adventure, piling into the car with our two daughters, Megan and Abbie, and heading to the North Coast, the Mourne Mountains, or the Fermanagh Lakelands. We're also never far from our Jack Russell Archie and our Staffy pup Hope, who keeps us all on our toes.

Our camera always comes with us, wherever we go. It's something we've always done naturally, and it's been lovely watching our girls pick up the same habit. For us, photography isn't something that stays at work, it's just part of how we see the world.

What We Do

Our style of photography is relaxed and informal. We're not big on stiff poses or awkward line ups, we'd much rather hang back and let things unfold naturally, stepping in to capture the laughter, the quiet moments, and the looks between you that you might not even remember happening.

That said, when it comes to your couple portraits and family shots, we'll give you just enough direction to make sure everything looks great without it ever feeling forced.

Why We Love Weddings and Photographs of People

Being invited into one of the most important days of someone's life never gets old. The energy, the emotion, the chaos, we love all of it. And unlike most types of photography, a wedding day asks you to be a photojournalist, a portrait photographer, a landscape photographer, a product photographer and sometimes even a sports photographer, all before the dancing. That variety is something we genuinely thrive on.

There's also something unique about photographing people rather than places. A photo of a person tells a story, their personality, their relationships, the moment they're living in. We've seen our couples use their wedding photos to celebrate anniversaries, honour loved ones they've lost, and mark milestones they never expected. That kind of lasting meaning is what makes this work feel worthwhile.

How We Became Wedding Photographers

We didn't know each other as kids, but we both started our photography journey the exact same way, with a Polaroid camera. That instant magic of pressing a button and watching a photo appear right in front of you hooked us both early, and honestly, it never really let go.

When we got together, we were that couple on holiday with a camera permanently attached. When we found out we were expecting our first daughter, things got more serious. We wanted to document everything, so we bought better cameras and quickly realised it wasn't the gear that made the difference, it was the skill. So we threw ourselves into learning, almost obsessively.

Tommy had been shooting model portfolios and commercial photography, when weddings came along completely by chance. A photographer he knew was stuck, their second shooter had dropped out days before a wedding and Tommy stepped in to help. He took to it immediately.

Laurene came along initially to help things run smoothly on the day. That arrangement lasted about five minutes before she was shooting too, and Pure Photo N.I became the husband and wife team it is today.

More than a decade and hundreds of weddings later, we're still just as excited as we were at the start.

Award Winning Wedding Photography

Over the years we've won multiple awards for our wedding photography. In 2026 we were named Best Wedding Photography Studio in Northern Ireland and won the Personalised Wedding Day Experience Excellence Award at the Small Business Awards, and in 2025 we were named Best Wedding Photography Team at the Northern Irish Enterprise Awards, with earlier wins going back to 2018.

Booking us

We're not pushy salespeople. It's just not us. You won't find us at wedding fairs or bridal shows. We'd rather let our portfolio do the talking, and if you like what you see, we'd love to hear from you.

Get in touch for a no pressure chat about your plans. We're always happy to answer questions, whatever stage you're at.

Where we are

We are based in Lisburn, Co. Antrim but are able to travel throughout Northern Ireland and further afield.

---

## Our Approach
Source: https://www.purephotoni.com/approach

Husband & Wife Team

We're Tommy and Laurene, a husband and wife wedding photography team based in Lisburn, Northern Ireland. Shooting together means you get two perspectives on your day, two pairs of eyes watching for the moments that matter, and a team that genuinely works together rather than two photographers who've just met.

What a Full Day of Wedding Photography Looks Like

Capturing the day as it happens (90%)
This is the heart of what we do. From the morning prep to the dancing, we photograph your day as it unfolds. No staging, no interrupting, no asking anyone to do that hug again. Two of us working together means we catch the moments you see and plenty of the ones you miss, so the photos feel like your actual wedding rather than a photo shoot.

Creative Portraits (5%)
The only time we borrow you. Thirty minutes, a short walk and a bit of good light is all it takes. No stiff posing, just the two of you getting a wee breather together while we work around you.

Relaxed Group Shots (5%)
Quick, organised and painless. We keep the group photos moving so they take up as little of your drinks reception as possible.

Getting to Know You

Every wedding we photograph is treated as a completely unique event. That starts from the very first time we chat. We'll take the time to get to know you both, your personalities, your plans, your back story, so that by the time your wedding day arrives, we already have a clear vision of how to tell your story.

Candid & Natural Moments

During the ceremony we work as discreetly as possible, but for the rest of the day we like to be involved. We chat with your guests, we join in the laughter, and we make ourselves part of the day rather than only observers of it.

Two Photographers, One Story

Our style blends creative portrait photography with documentary shooting, and having two of us in the room changes what's possible. While one of us photographs the first kiss, the other is on the reaction two rows back. One shoots wide to take in the whole scene, the other goes close on the detail. Same moment, two angles, and a story told more completely than one photographer ever could.

Featured review: "Not just 100%, we would 1000% recommend Pure Photo N.I. Honestly we have never been so happy that we found Tommy and Laurene to do our wedding photos." (Mr. & Mrs. Gaston)

## Prices and Packages
Source: https://www.purephotoni.com/pricing

Wedding photography prices in Northern Ireland

Four clear packages, from £1,375 for half day coverage to £2,675 for a full day with albums. Whichever you choose, you get both of us, the same relaxed and candid photography, and your gallery within six weeks.

Moments, half day, £1,375
Getting ready to the call for dinner, speeches included if they are before dinner. Album available to add later.

Story, full day, £1,675
Getting ready to first dance and 2 songs. Album available to add later.

Forever, full day and album, £2,075 (most popular)
Getting ready to first dance and 2 songs. 30 x 20 Storybook album.

Legacy, full day and extras, £2,675
Getting ready to first dance and 2 songs. 40 x 30 Storybook album, 2 parent book albums and an engagement session.

Every package includes two photographers (a husband and wife team), travel throughout Northern Ireland, high resolution digital images, a private online gallery to download and share, an in gallery shop for prints and wall art, and delivery within six weeks.

Extras
Fast edit, plus £400, photos guaranteed within ten days of your wedding instead of six weeks. Venues outside Northern Ireland, travel quote. Bespoke coverage such as a second day or a few extra hours, just ask. Engagement sessions at half price once you have booked, and included with Legacy. Elopements and micro weddings have their own packages.

Two photographers, one story
Every package includes both of us, so you never pay extra for a second photographer. During your ceremony one of us stays on the two of you while the other catches your family and friends reacting.

How booking works
1. Check your date. Send us your date and venue, or message us on WhatsApp, and we will tell you straight away if we are free.
2. Secure it. Your date is yours once you sign our contract and pay the £400 booking fee, which is non refundable. The balance is due four weeks before your wedding.
3. Your wedding day. Both of us are with you, capturing the day as it happens.
4. Your gallery. Delivered within six weeks, in a private online gallery you can share and order prints from.

## Wedding FAQ
Source: https://www.purephotoni.com/wedding-faq

Our style and where we work

What style of photography do you specialise in for weddings?
We specialise in documentary wedding photography in Northern Ireland, blended with relaxed artistic portraits. We love capturing candid moments that reflect the real atmosphere of every wedding, while also creating portraits that show off the two of you, your venue and all the details that make up your day. We always aim to keep everything stress free when it comes to your wedding photography. We want you to have the best day of your lives, and we want to capture all the smiles, laughter and tears that come with it.

Where are you based and what areas do you cover?
We are based in Lisburn, just outside Belfast, and we cover all of Northern Ireland as standard, including Belfast, the North Coast, the Mourne Mountains and everywhere in between. You can read more about our city weddings on our wedding photographer Belfast page. We have also photographed weddings in the Republic of Ireland and would be happy to travel to the UK mainland. If you are dreaming of a destination wedding further afield, in Europe or beyond, just get in touch and we will make it work.

Do you have insurance?
Yes, we have public liability insurance. Some venues in Northern Ireland ask photographers for proof of this before the wedding, so if yours does, just let us know and we will send the documents across directly.

Do you offer engagement sessions?
Yes. An engagement session is a lovely way for us to get to know each other better, and for you to get comfortable in front of the camera before the big day. One is included with our Legacy package, and if you have booked us for your wedding you can add one at half price. Take a look at our engagement photography sessions.

Do you shoot video too, or can you recommend videographers?
We focus entirely on photography, because it is what we do best and what we love. Over the years we have built great working relationships with a number of talented videographers in Northern Ireland, and we are happy to point you in the right direction based on your style and budget. Just ask us when we chat.

Booking your date and coverage

How much does wedding photography cost?
Our four wedding photography packages start at £1,375 for half day coverage and go up to £2,675 for a full day with albums and an engagement session. Every package includes both of us, travel within Northern Ireland, a private online gallery and an online print shop. You can see exactly what each one includes on our wedding photography prices page.

Can you hold provisional wedding dates?
Unfortunately not. Wedding dates are always in short supply, so we work on a strict first come, first served basis. Your date is confirmed once we have received your booking fee and you have signed a contract with us.

How long will you stay at our wedding?
That depends on the package you choose. Moments covers getting ready through to the call for dinner, and we stay for the speeches if they are on before dinner. Story, Forever and Legacy take you right through to your first dance and a couple of songs after that. We also have options for micro weddings and elopements.

Do you charge extra for travel?
We do not charge travel fees for weddings anywhere in Northern Ireland, including Belfast, Lisburn and the North Coast. For weddings in the Republic of Ireland or further afield, a fee for mileage and accommodation, if needed, will apply. We always keep these costs as low as we can.

How many photographers will there be?
We are a husband and wife team and we much prefer working together, as it gives our couples the best coverage. All of our wedding photography packages include both of us on the day. If you would prefer just one photographer, contact us for a bespoke quote.

Do you photograph both the bride and the groom getting ready?
All of our wedding photography packages include coverage of the bride getting ready. We can also photograph the groom getting ready if you are both getting ready at the same place, or a short distance from each other. As we work together as a team, groom prep means leaving the bride a little earlier to allow time to get to the groom. Here is why we do not always photograph the groom getting ready. For same sex weddings, this means that if you are getting ready in different places you may need to decide which of you has getting ready coverage. We can also look into hiring another photographer to cover your partner getting ready, at an additional cost and depending on their availability.

On your wedding day

What if I am not comfortable in front of the camera?
You are definitely not on your own. We have photographed hundreds of weddings together since 2014, and most people, even those who happily pose for selfies, feel a little nervous about being photographed by someone else. That is completely normal. We use our experience to put you at ease and keep everything natural and fun. By the time we are finished, it will feel like you have spent some time with old friends who happened to take some photos.

What is a first look and is it included?
A first look is when the two of you see each other for the first time on your wedding day, before the ceremony. It is a personal choice, but it can help ease nerves and gives you a special moment together. We are always happy to include one if it is something you want to do. Read more about the benefits of a first look.

What happens if it rains on our wedding day?
Living in Northern Ireland, we are experts at working with the liquid sunshine. Rain does not ruin wedding photos, and it can actually add a beautiful, romantic atmosphere. We always scout your venue for the best indoor spots with natural light, like grand staircases, large windows or arched doorways, so we can still create lovely portraits without getting you wet. We always carry clear umbrellas in the car too, which look fantastic in photos and keep you dry. We keep a close eye on the weather all day, and if there is a break in the clouds we will whisk you outside for five or ten minutes to get those outdoor photos you have dreamed of.

Your photographs and albums

Do you back up the photos?
Absolutely. Your images are far too important to leave to chance. Both of us shoot with cameras that have two memory card slots, so every photo is written to two cards at the same time. As soon as we get home from your wedding, we back everything up to multiple hard drives, so your images are never in just one place.

How many images will we receive?
It varies with the length of your coverage and the size of your wedding. We deliver all of the best images from your day, every meaningful moment, big and small, with unflattering frames removed. There is no set number because every wedding is different, but you will never feel you have missed out.

How will we receive our photographs?
You will get a password protected online gallery where you can view and download all of your edited images, and share them with family and friends. To see how it works, you can view a demo gallery.

When will we receive them?
We deliver your wedding gallery within six weeks of your wedding. If you would like your photos sooner, our fast edit add on guarantees delivery within ten days for an extra £400.

What about copyright?
All the images we deliver are licensed for your personal use, including prints, albums, social media and sharing with family and friends. The copyright itself stays with us as the photographers, which is standard practice across the industry. If a venue, supplier or business wants to use your images commercially, online or in print, they will need to ask us for permission first. Read more about image usage rights and copyright.

What about prints and wall art?
Every gallery includes access to an online shop, so you can easily order prints and wall art from the UK’s best professional print labs. They do not usually sell to the public, so it is a great way to get professional quality prints. You are of course free to use another printing company or make prints yourself.

Do we have to decide on an album right now?
No. If you book our Moments or Story package, you can decide on an album after you have received your images. Our Forever and Legacy packages both include albums.

When will we receive our storybook wedding album?
Albums are usually delivered within eight weeks of you confirming your order.

Payment and booking

How much is the booking fee and when do we pay the balance?
All four of our wedding photography packages have a £400 non refundable booking fee, paid when you book. The balance for your package is due four weeks before your wedding.

What payment options are available?
Bank transfer is our preferred way to pay, but we can also take card payments if you prefer. Just let us know.

How do we make a booking?
We use an automated online booking system. Send us your details using the form below, or email us at info@purephotoni.com, and we will add your information to our booking system and send you everything you need to confirm your booking.
